title: The Kerala Small Plantation Workers' Welfare Fund Act 2008
full_text: The Kerala Small Plantation Workers' Welfare Fund Act 2008 2008-ലെ കേരള ചെറുകിട തോട്ടം തൊഴിലാളി ക്ഷേമനിധി ആക്റ്റ് Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 200818 Act Number: 18 Enactment Date: 2008-04-01 Act Year: 2008 Short Title: The Kerala Small Plantation Workers' Welfare Fund Act 2008 Hindi Title: 2008-ലെ കേരള ചെറുകിട തോട്ടം തൊഴിലാളി ക്ഷേമനിധി ആക്റ്റ് Long Title: An Act to provide for the constitution of a Fund for promoting the welfare of, and to pay pension to the workers in small plantations in the State of Kerala and for certain other matters connected therewith.
